display_long_description:
The open road, from the driver's seat - in Malibu.

A REAL CALIFORNIA LOOP
A 50-mile loop built from real map data: south on the Pacific Coast Highway with the ocean on your right, past Malibu Pier and the Santa Monica Pier with the Pacific Wheel turning, east on the 10, north on the 405 over the Sepulveda Pass past the Getty, west on the 101 through the Valley, then down Malibu Canyon back to the coast.

A SHOW TRUCK TO CALL HOME
Walnut dash, fourteen working gauges and a starlight headliner. Reach out with your own hands: grip the wheel, pull the air horn, set the parking brake - or drive with the joysticks.

A REAL 10-SPEED
Pick AUTOMATIC and just drive, or switch to MANUAL and float a 10-speed through the H-pattern with a LO/HI range. Match the revs and it drops in. Miss it and it grinds.

HAUL REAL LOADS
Six depots: Citiview Freight - Malibu, Topanga Truck Stop, Palisades Produce, Sawtelle Logistics, Sherman Oaks Terminal and Calabasas Foods. Back under your trailer, take the load from dispatch, merge into traffic and deliver it. Dock it clean for a bonus and climb the ranks.

DAY AND NIGHT
Noon with the Pacific beside you, or after dark with the Pacific Wheel lit up. Night runs pay extra.

ON THE RADIO
A real dispatcher and five truckers on the CB. Everything in miles and mph.

THE SLEEPER
Parked for the night? Leave the seat, walk back into the sleeper and sleep through to morning.

Plus achievements, truck paints to unlock, a live map and seat settings.
